services.name: Lakeview Park Campground
services.desc: Please note that as of September 8th, 2026, Lakeview Park Campground is closed for the season. The site will undergo maintenance throughout the fall/winter. Stay tuned for updates regarding bookings for 2027. We hope to welcome you all back here in the spring! The reservation system is closed and will re-open for bookings - Date and Time to be Determined in early 2027. All reservations for 2027 must be made online on our booking website. A rate of $44 per site is in effect for each night with an additional fee of $14 per night for a powered site.
